A GitHub actions workflow to:
1) Compile the LaTeX manuscript to pdf with [Xu Cheng's latex-action](https://github.com/xu-cheng/latex-action).
2) Compress the pdf using Ghostscript with [jy95's ghostscript-action](https://github.com/jy95/ghostscript-action).
3) Upload the compressed pdf to the [Liedlab GitHub Page](https://liedllab.github.io/gist/) with [James Ives' github-pages-deploy-action](https://github.com/JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action).
